Q: Query to select a value of a column of a table identified by a value of another table A:

So you need to join together all rows from A by ID_A and the matching values from the other tables. Let's see:

SELECT 55 AS ID_A
       Nome_B, Cogn_B,
       Nome_C, Cogn_C,
       Nome_D, Cogn_D
FROM (SELECT 1 AS foo) t
LEFT JOIN A A_B ON A_B.ID_A = 55 AND tbl = 1
LEFT JOIN B ON A_B.sogg_ID = B.ID_B
LEFT JOIN A A_C ON A_C.ID_A = 55 AND tbl = 2
LEFT JOIN C ON A_C.sogg_ID = C.ID_C
LEFT JOIN A A_D ON A_D.ID_A = 55 AND tbl = 3
LEFT JOIN D ON A_D.sogg_ID = D.ID_D;

Explanation:

  • we LEFT JOIN A and alias it as A_B, A_C and A_D, respectively for all the dimensions we need by ID_A being the value you need and tbl being the corresponding table
  • LEFT JOIN defaults to NULL if their is no right-hand match
  • we LEFT JOIN B, C and D, respectively to their counterparts in A, B and C
  • we do a dummy selection in the FROM clause to make sure we can LEFT JOIN everything to it, so if you don't have a B-value, a C-value or a D-value, then your query will still work

Or you could do

SELECT ID_A, Nome_B AS Nome, Cogn_B AS Cogn
FROM A
JOIN B
ON A.ID_A = 55 AND tbl = 1 AND sogg_ID = B.ID_B
UNION ALL
SELECT ID_A, Nome_C AS Nome, Cogn_C AS Cogn
FROM A
JOIN C
ON A.ID_A = 55 AND tbl = 2 AND sogg_ID = C.ID_C
UNION ALL
SELECT ID_A, Nome_D AS Nome, Cogn_D AS Cogn
FROM A
JOIN D
ON A.ID_A = 55 AND tbl = 3 AND sogg_ID = D.ID_D

The first approach makes everything related to row 22 part of a single row, whereas the second approach breaks things into different rows.

EDIT

However, even though the task is solvable, it makes more sense to make ID_A unique in A, remove sogg_ID from A and have an ID_A foreign key in B, C and D.

Q: mysqli_free_result(), Returning A Warning A:

You can in fact mix procedural and object style. But still, it is best to stick to one style in your code.

Even if you were using the procedural approach, what you have done is incorrect because fetch_row() returns an array, and mysqli_free_result() would expect the result resource - you would need to do:

mysqli_free_result($mysqli_result);

Q: Can you help me make my code less messy and more readable? A:

Your code is well structured because it separates out the different parts of the game into their own functions. The main loop is a loop (as it should be) and does not use recursion as I see too often.

The loop in new_game() does not need to initialise and adjust question_num because you can use enumerate() for that.

The only thing actually wrong is the second loop in display_score() since you break out after the first iteration. Neither that loop nor the one before it actually need to be loops.

See my version of your code below:

def new_game(): #the function where all the game logic is
    guesses = [] #the guesses the user had
    correct_guesses = 0
    for num,quest in enumerate(questions): #i specifically wanna shorten this part downward
        print('---------------------------------------------------------')
        print(quest)
        for option in options[num]:
            print(option)
        guess = input("enter (A, B, C or D):  ").upper()
        guesses.append(guess)
        correct_guesses += check_answers(questions[quest], guess)  #everytime it's correct it adds 1 and 0 if wrong

    display_score(correct_guesses, guesses)

def check_answers(answer, user_guess):
    if answer == user_guess:
        print("CORRECT")
        return 1
    else:
        print("WRONG")
        return 0    
 
def display_score(correct_guess, guess):
    print("-----------------------------------------")
    print("RESULT:")
    print("-----------------------------------------")
    print("Answers: ", ' '.join(questions.values()))
    print("Your guesses: ", " ".join(guess))

    score=int((correct_guess/len(guess))*100)#percentage user got
    print("score: ", score, "%")

def play_again():
    play = input("do you wanna play again(y/n)? ").lower()
    if play == "y":
        return True
    else:
        return False
    
questions={"who created python? ": "B",
           "From where is the name 'python' originating? ":"C",
           "What year did the second ww started?": "A",
           "What was UsainBolt time in 2009?": "C"}

options=[['A.Bjarne stroute', 'B.Guido Von Rossum', 'C.Alexander Cobol', 'D.Blaise Pascal'],
         ['A.from the python snake', 'B.from his mother heart disease', 'C.From music band Monty python', 'D.None'],
         ["A.1939", "B.1969","C.1200'A.D'", 'D.2001'],
         ['A.9.2', 'B.7.67', 'C.9.58', 'D.10.05']]

while True:    #loop that restarts the code if play_again is true
    new_game()
    if not play_again():
        break

print("\nBye")

Q: How can I connect HTML and Python without using any libraries or frameworks? A:

@furas Uh, I use it. My websites are on inexpensive, shared servers where WSGI is not available and I do not have the ability to restart the webserver necessitated by program changes when using WSGI (unless you have some other solution). So, for me CGI is the only real solution. Note that my applications are very low volume, so creating a new process with each request is not an issue.

Q: Selenium WebDriver Exception The HTTP request to the remote WebDriver server for URL xyz Timed out after x seconds A:

I feel like I've found some solution that make work for somebody. So I've ran 100+ test cases with Selenium with usage of TeamCity Agent. Almost every time atleast one test failed with such an error:

09:30:12 OpenQA.Selenium.WebDriverException : An unknown exception was encountered sending an HTTP request to the remote WebDriver server for URL http://localhost:10458/session/e050c5112562c1539c7518353fa3cce2/element. The exception message was: No connection could be made because the target machine actively refused it. (localhost:10458) 09:30:12
----> System.Net.Http.HttpRequestException : No connection could be made because the target machine actively refused it. (localhost:10458) 09:30:12 ----> System.Net.Sockets.SocketException : No connection could be made because the target machine actively refused it.

I've checked the proxy on server which run the tests, firewall, set config that most of the time, people described as a fix. For example:

   "--no-sandbox",
    "--proxy-server='direct://'",
    "--proxy-bypass-list=*",

But it didn't solve any problem. So at the time I was using .NET 6.0 With up to date chromedriver ChromeDriver 113.0.5672.63.

What worked was the downgrade of .NET 6.0 to .NET 5.0
